This '''T-series tactical droid''' served in the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], he was the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] army on [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], in which he led his [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces on the verge of [[Battle of Malastare/Legends|conquering]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, he was destroyed when the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] forces dropped the [[Electro-proton bomb/Legends|electro-proton bomb]], which deactivated all of the droid units.

{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
This tactical droid was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]].

In a reference to the [[Wikipedia:Godzilla|''Godzilla'']] films, the symbol on the droid's chest resembles the [[Wikipedia:Oxygen Destroyer|Oxygen Destroyer]] that was used to kill Godzilla in the original 1954 film.<ref name="Return of red">{{SW|url=video/the-zillo-beast-episode-featurette|text="The Zillo Beast" Episode Featurette}}</ref>
